profile.headline: Android & Unity Developer | 10+ Years | Bilingual | Built Games & Apps for Play Store/iOS | Remote Ready
profile.summary:
I’m a bilingual software developer with over 10 years of experience building scalable web, mobile, and cloud applications. My background spans Android, Unity, and full-stack development, with strong skills in Java, C#, JavaScript, and Apex.

I enjoy solving complex problems with clean, efficient code — whether it’s integrating APIs, automating workflows, or improving user experiences. Over the years, I’ve led projects from concept to launch across both startups and enterprise environments, delivering tools that make technology more accessible and effective.

I’m currently expanding into Salesforce and cloud automation through Trailhead and hands-on projects, bringing my development mindset to the world of CRM and data-driven solutions.

If you’re working on something that bridges creativity, data, and technology — I’d love to connect.

💡 I’m currently open to remote or hybrid roles in:

Android Development

Unity Game Development

QA, Testing, or IT Support (contract or full-time)


Let's connect, especially if you're looking for a strong dev with grit, range, and a passion for problem-solving
